## The review itself

Started in the background by the chat tool, or by the weekly trigger. It
reads Xero, works out what it can on its own, asks Claude about the rest,
and saves one row per transaction.

The order matters. Everything the deterministic pass settles never reaches
the model at all: the user's own rules first, then an exact invoice, then a
transaction already in Xero, then unanimous history. Only what is genuinely
unclear costs a model call.

It writes nothing to Xero and sends nothing anywhere.
